'''Tor Cordol''' was an individual who was a member of the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] organization [[Cordol's Chain]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Cordol participated in a Cordol's Chain attack on [[TechTank shop|the shop]] of the [[Outlaw tech/Legends|outlaw tech]] gang [[TechTank]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].
